title: Section and primitive-unit calculus for ordinary evaluation
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell, a scheme map f:X -> Y, and n>=0. The primitive direct-image functor of lem-pur-completed-primitive-counit-comparison agrees with the direct-image functor of def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems. Its commutation with nth evaluation is equality of functors. The resulting eqToIso comparison acts as identity on every section over U in Y.ProEt, for every strict coefficient system on X. The primitive inverse-evaluation comparison satisfies its defining adjunction-unit equation as an equality of module-sheaf morphisms. There are no assumptions on the transitions, and n denotes quotient exponent n+1.

source.place: Tags 03D3 and 03D8; the unit normalization and sectionwise direct image in PrimitiveCounitEvaluation

proof.text: Unfold the two direct-image presentations. Their section rings and constant-section maps agree definitionally, giving direct_eq. Rewrite this equality in PrimitiveCounit.directEvaluation_eq to obtain the integral direct-evaluation functor equality. Define its comparison by eqToIso.

For any equality F=G of module-sheaf-valued functors, equality elimination shows that each component of eqToIso acts heterogeneously as the identity function on sections. Specialize to directEvaluation_eq and apply congr_heq at a section. Both section carriers are the same underlying module carrier, proving the asserted equality.

Unfold the chosen primitive inverseEvaluation. The first conjunct of the chosen witness specification from inverseEvaluation_existsUnique is exactly its unit equation. Specialize it at the arbitrary system M.
